week-start op: must invoke account-snapshot for each account

week-start op: must run task-sync after setting priorities
week-start op: output must have all required sections

evals.prompt: orient me — what do I have today?
evals.expected_behavior: If no today-dated brief.json, runs the full pipeline (task-sync first), then synthesizes whispers -> Today -> Slack threads -> staleness flags instead of dumping raw output
assertions: Checks for a today-dated brief.json and only runs the full pipeline when it is missing or the operator demands fresh
Runs /task-sync before synthesizing so mobile edits reach Today
Presents whispers first, then Today, then unanswered Slack threads, then staleness flags — synthesis, not a dump
States cache age instead of presenting stale data as current when a refresh failed
Reports native qualification as pending or unavailable and never substitutes historical local scores; points to /grill for an exact read-only review

evals.prompt: what about the platform deal? (asked right after this morning's pulse)
evals.expected_behavior: Answers the follow-up from today's cached brief.json without re-running the pipeline
assertions: Answers from the existing today-dated brief.json rather than re-pulling live SF/Gmail
Would still run the full refresh if the operator said 'pull latest' or '--fresh'

evals.prompt: start the week — it's Monday morning
evals.expected_behavior: Routes to the week-start op and runs the full start-of-week orchestration
assertions: Reads ops/week-start.md rather than treating this as the daily brief
Runs fieldkit sync --sf
Generates pipeline review
Creates per-account snapshots
Checks project health for zombies and expiring projects
Presents top 5 priority suggestions and confirms before writing
Writes confirmed priorities to the TASKS.md Today section

evals.prompt: set up my week but skip the account snapshots
evals.expected_behavior: Runs the week-start op with snapshot generation skipped
assertions: Skips account snapshot generation
Still runs data sync, pipeline review, and priority setting

evals.prompt: close out the week — Friday wrap
evals.expected_behavior: Routes to the week-end op and runs the full close-out
assertions: Reads ops/week-end.md rather than treating this as the daily brief
Checks SF data freshness and next steps for all active pursuits
Audits Waiting On items for overdue follow-ups
Summarises tasks completed and meetings this week
Prompts for lessons learned
Drafts the 1:1 update via the meeting skill's one-on-one op
Resets TASKS.md and syncs to Google Tasks

evals.prompt: end of week wrap-up, but don't draft the 1:1
evals.expected_behavior: Runs the week-end op without the 1:1 draft step
assertions: Runs all steps except the 1:1 draft
Still does SF hygiene, follow-up audit, and tasks reset

evals.prompt: prep for next week but leave my tasks alone
evals.expected_behavior: Runs the week-end op without resetting TASKS.md
assertions: Skips the TASKS.md reset
Still does SF hygiene, follow-up audit, lessons, and 1:1 draft

evals.prompt: catch me up — I've been in meetings all morning, what did I miss?
evals.expected_behavior: Routes to the update op for a mid-session refresh, not a full start-of-day run
assertions: Reads ops/update.md rather than re-running the full start-of-day brief
Reads TASKS.md
Checks sf_last_pulled for each pursuit (flags > 7 days)
Pulls Backstory signals via the fieldkit-sales group
Produces an Update complete summary
Uses 'fieldkit gmail sync' not 'uv run python -m fieldkit gmail sync'

evals.prompt: give me a comprehensive refresh of what's changed
evals.expected_behavior: Runs the update op in comprehensive mode — full refresh plus deep Gmail and calendar scan
assertions: Runs 'fieldkit gmail sync' and 'fieldkit gmail account-tags'
Queries recent activity using the --since flag (not --days)
Runs 'fieldkit gmail decay <account>' for each account
Runs 'fieldkit gmail query blindspots' for new contacts
